programs.description:
What the Reminder Teams Built Around MSC 

The teams intentionally chose a design where MSC does not own reminder functionality itself. 

Instead: 

MSC owns 
  • content metadata 
  • availability information 
  • lifecycle states 
  • release timing signals 

Reminder Services own 
  • storing reminders 
  • reminder collections 
  • user reminder state 
  • reminder triggering 
  • notification requests 
  • moving items from Reminders to My List 

The architecture specifically describes: 
  • a dedicated Reminder Service 
  • Reminder Processing Service 
  • content state change detection 
  • notification triggering 
  • automatic movement into My List after reminder fulfillment
programs.shortDescription: Allow users to see a "New Season" badge and set a reminder.

programs.name: Dynamic Ratings Over on Pre-roll Promos
programs.latestStatus: MSC catalog feed is the blocker. Decisioning path is otherwise ready for staging.
programs.orgRelationship: Depends on MSC catalog rights feed for offer eligibility.
programs.description:
In simple terms: 
  • CEP supplies the ratings data 
  • CMP builds the service that serves it 
  • Playback consumes the service and displays the overlays 

Capabililities
Rating source data - CEP/Conent Rating pipeline
Playback Metadata Service - CMP 
Ratings snapshot worker - CMP 
Territory/rating selection logic - CMP 
Localization + icon resolution  - CMP 
Infrastructure & monitoring - CMP 
Playback integration - Playback / Media Distillery 
Player rendering of overlays - Playback ecosystem
programs.shortDescription: Overlay rating and descriptors on pre-roll promos in markets where legally required.

programs.name: Saved Views in Studio Apps
programs.latestStatus: Patrick Decker will demo the new capability 10/7
programs.orgRelationship: Commerce + MSC offers; Platform Core supplies decisioning.
programs.description: Saved Views provides a native-to-Studio means to save the keyword and/or filters of a search in order to easily access it as part of the BAU workflow in an app. The function is intended to be available to all Studio apps which support keyword search and/or or filtering with the known exception of Site Builder, which has native functionality that does not overlap with Studio Foundation components or patterns.
programs.shortDescription: Saved Views provides a native-to-Studio way to save the keyword and/or filters of a search in order to easily access it as part of the BAU workflow in an app.
